fullPassage: In some cases, objects are members of the same category not because they are highly similar in appearance but because they serve similar functions. For example, planes, trains, and automobiles do not look very similar to each other, but they are all means of transportation. In still other cases, exemplars become associated because they have some connection to each other based on some higher meaning. Attending church, donating money to a faith-based charity, and bowing one's head before meals are very different specific behavioral acts, and it is not immediately apparent that they serve the same function. All of them, though, are excellent exemplars that reflect the individual's religiosity. The concept of religiosity provides a meaning structure that ties these behaviors together in a single category simply because they are different manifestations of the same underlying concept. Thus, categories need to have some explanatory function. A category is more than a set of elements that are grouped based merely on perceived similarities and differences; a category is also a theory that gives some account for why these elements, but not other elements, are included in the category. This explanation provides the "glue" that holds the category together.

questions.passage: A category is more than a set of elements that are __________ (group) based merely on perceived similarities and differences; a category is also a theory.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: elements that are ______ 구조에서 '그룹화된다'는 수동의 의미이므로 group → grouped(과거분사). 관계절 내 수동태 구조
det.tip: be + p.p. 수동태: are grouped = 그룹화된다

questions.passage: In some cases, objects are members of the same category not because they are highly similar in appearance but because they serve similar functions. For example, planes, trains, and automobiles do not look very similar to each other, but they are all means of transportation. In still other cases, exemplars become associated because they have some connection to each other __________. Attending church, donating money to a faith-based charity, and bowing one's head before meals are very different specific behavioral acts, and it is not immediately apparent that they serve the same function. All of them, though, are excellent exemplars that reflect the individual's religiosity. The concept of religiosity provides a meaning structure that ties these behaviors together in a single category simply because they are different manifestations of the same underlying concept. Thus, categories need to have some explanatory function. A category is more than a set of elements that are grouped based merely on perceived similarities and differences; a category is also a theory that gives some account for why these elements, but not other elements, are included in the category. This explanation provides the "glue" that holds the category together.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 더 높은 의미에 기반한 연결로 exemplar들이 연관된다는 맥락
det.analysis:
① based on appearance: 외모 기반 — 앞 문장에서 부족하다고 했음
② without any connection: 연결 없이 — 의미 반대
③ in single elements: 개별 요소 안에서 — 연결 맥락과 부적합
④ based on some higher meaning: 더 높은 의미에 기반하여 ←정답
det.tip: based on some higher meaning=더 높은 의미에 기반하여

det.korean: 카테고리가 왜 특정 요소들을 포함하는지 설명해주는 이론이라는 맥락
